title: Russian Drone Strike Triggers Ammunition Detonations Near Kyiv, Killing at Least 37
detail: Around 8:10 p.m. local time on August 28, a Russian drone struck or crashed into a storage facility in the village of Myla, roughly 5 kilometers west of Kyiv along the Kyiv-Chop highway, sparking a large fire followed by a chain of ammunition detonations. Ukrainian prosecutors said the facility appeared to have been storing explosive materials and opened an investigation into possible criminal negligence for storing munitions near residential areas. By the afternoon of August 29, officials raised the confirmed toll to at least 37 killed and 42 injured, including 4 children, with 4 people still missing; at least 50 residential buildings, a care facility for elderly and disabled residents, and multiple warehouses were damaged or destroyed. Russia's Defense Ministry said its forces struck an arms depot storing drone-manufacturing equipment. President Zelensky said ammunition must never be stored near homes and that criminal cases had already been opened over the incident. The strike came as part of a broader overnight campaign in which Russia launched roughly 598 drones and 31 missiles — including 2 Kh-47 Kinzhal ballistic missiles, 9 Iskander-M/KN-23 ballistic missiles, and 20 Kh-101 cruise missiles — against Kyiv and other regions for a second consecutive night.

title: Ukraine's SBU Strikes Second Tu-95MS Bomber at Engels-2 Airbase, Hits Yaroslavl Refinery
detail: The Security Service of Ukraine's (SBU) Special Operations Center 'Alpha' struck a Russian Tu-95MS strategic bomber-missile carrier at the Engels-2 airbase in Saratov Oblast, roughly 800km from the Ukrainian border, using long-range attack drones, President Zelensky said on August 28. Satellite imagery reviewed by analysts showed the bomber missing part of a wing and assessed as non-repairable — the second Tu-95 destroyed or critically damaged at Engels-2 in six weeks, following a July 16 strike. In the same 24-hour window, Ukraine's Defense Forces also struck an oil refinery in Russia's Yaroslavl Oblast, about 1,000km from the front line, as part of what Zelensky said was a 16-target overnight campaign against Russian military and energy infrastructure.

title: Zelensky Orders Military to Scale Long-Range Drone Strikes to 1,000 a Day
detail: In his evening address on August 28, President Zelensky said he has ordered Ukraine's armed forces to increase long-range drone strikes against Russia to at least 1,000 per day, more than triple the current average of roughly 300. He said the goal was set at a meeting of the Staff of the Supreme Commander-in-Chief and is aimed at strengthening deep strikes on Russian military and energy infrastructure while bolstering air defense against jet-powered Shahed-type drones. Separately the same day, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Russia-Ukraine peace talks remain on a 'deep pause,' with Moscow 'pressing forward with the special military operation' as Russian troops continue offensive operations in eastern Ukraine — even as CIA Director John Ratcliffe visited Moscow and a Vatican envoy met Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov this week to press for a deal.
